title: Edoardo Mancini
text:
About Me
I am a Senior Data Scientist working at Roche in the UK. My work involves leading statistical programming activities in early and late-stage clinical trials. I am also a passionate advocate for R and Open Source, and am able to pursue these interests in my current role as Business Lead for the {admiral} R package.
Outside of work, I enjoy playing chess, reading, and running.
